edits.new_content:
with source as (
    select * from {{ source('raw', 'observations') }}
),

renamed as (
    select
        repository,
        captured_at,
        stars,
        forks,
        watchers,
        open_issues_and_prs
    from source
)

select * from renamed

version: 2

models:
  - name: stg_observations
    columns:
      - name: repository
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: captured_at
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: stars
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: forks
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: watchers
      - name: open_issues_and_prs
